target: install.sh (Step 7 kernel checksums) vs kernel/GOVERNANCE.md Section 4
summary: After BL-014, GOVERNANCE.md defines a canonical four-file sha256sum command on kernel/*.md paths and .azoth/kernel-checksums.sha256. install.sh hashes .azoth/kernel/*.md after copy, which is semantically aligned but uses a glob and may differ in ordering or wording from the documented explicit path list. Reviewer flagged aligning mechanical artifacts with the chosen canonical form.
evidence: install.sh lines ~244-249 use sha256sum .azoth/kernel/*.md or shasum -a 256 .azoth/kernel/*.md. kernel/GOVERNANCE.md Section 4 specifies explicit paths kernel/BOOTLOADER.md, GOVERNANCE.md, PROMOTION_RUBRIC.md, TRUST_CONTRACT.md and sha256sum -c. Consumer tree uses .azoth/kernel/ mirror; spec is written for repo kernel/ — intentional split but easy to confuse at bootstrap.
recommended_action: Add a short comment in install.sh Step 7 referencing GOVERNANCE Section 4 (and consumer path equivalence), and/or use the same four explicit basenames in lexicographic order for stable output. Optionally add a one-line pointer in GOVERNANCE Section 4 that post-install verification uses .azoth/kernel/*.md. Route work as infrastructure/backlog item; delivery_pipeline standard.
